invariants.rationale: Partition path should typically be a valid, non-null string.
The provided list of file slices should be non-null as method likely performs operations on it.
Method guarantees a non-null return value unless a contract violation occurs.
The left component (stream of clustering groups) in the result pair should not be null.
The right component (Boolean flag) in the result pair should not be null, given the method signature.
